observations: Steal An Egg still leads Most Popular, with Brookhaven and Throw Food For Animals behind it; six games entered and six left.
Fisch and Throw a Seed rose 23 places each, and Scare Your Favorite Streamer rose 16, while Ragdoll Experiment, Kit PVP FFA and Volley Bomb each fell 15-16.
Median pillar percentile is 38-40 for games aged 15-84 days against 64 for those over a year old, so age still explains much of the rank.
patterns: Solo loops tend to sit lower (70%, down from 84%), consistent with higher positions going to multiplayer games; visit count is the strongest link but is partly an outcome of success.
A higher favorite rate per visit goes with lower Most Popular positions, since big evergreens convert fewer visits into favorites.

outliers.name: Throw Food For Animals
outliers.note: A solo-style throw-for-rarity game at #3 after 66 days; its clone family is spreading to the breakout charts.

observations: Top Earning has 480 games, with 19 new entries and 17 fallen off today; 100 Miles Down the River rose 181 places.
Games older than 366 days have a median pillar percentile of 64 against 23 for the 15-42 day group, so age remains the strongest single link to monetization efficiency.
Median product price, premium passes above 999 R$, story-adventure and roleplay loops all go with better efficiency; sandbox physics and pets/eggs go with worse.
patterns: Tower defense tends to earn well for its CCU: Anime Crusaders X (#24), Garden Tower Defense (#157), Dragon Tower Defense (#177), Anime Nexus RNG X (#187) and Retro Tower Defense (#308) all sit on the chart, with high product counts (78-274 products) and gem or seed packs.

Pet-style throw and pack games (Steal an Anime Pack #232, Fish A Pirate #443) sell luck spins and boosts up to 3599 R$, but the pet/egg and steal-base hypotheses suggest they earn less per player than their position implies.

outliers.name: Dragon Tower Defense
outliers.note: No game passes at all, yet it holds #177 with 78 developer products, so monetization is carried by coin and luck products.

outliers.name: Roblox classics (Evade, Slap Battles, Horse Life)
outliers.note: Years-old games with hundreds of products stay on the chart through scale, not novelty.

observations: Of the 97 on Top Trending, 72 are young enough to be scored; Stand Out rose 57 and Anime Crusaders X rose 43 on an anniversary part 2 update, Fish For Sea Animals rose 38.
Four-week-old games dominate the best performers; Ragdoll titles make up 12% of the chart but trail within age (r=-0.56).
patterns: Physics sandboxes may climb more slowly within age (-0.48), consistent with the ragdoll wave saturating.
Games with a page video tend to climb faster (70%), and reward-flex thumbnails with huge odds numbers (1 in 98M) appear on the newest collection games.

outliers.name: Anime Crusaders X
outliers.note: 565 days old but jumped 43 places on a limited anniversary event, so older games can move on this chart when a big update lands.

observations: Up-and-Coming has 25 new entries and 24 exits; Defeat Ragdolls for Powers rose 64 and Tumble Dash rose 57.

Today's queue shows plane-crash physics (Pleb's #18, Realistic Plane Crashing #38), throw-for-rarity (Clowns #47, Cast For Fish #63, Throw a Friend #77) and satisfying-task games (Deep Clean ASMR #45, Unscrew Every Screw #65, Slime Studio #70) filling the chart.
Visit count and novelty go with higher positions within age; redeem codes and update tags in the title go with lower.
patterns: Pages with a video rank higher within age (81%), and shorter titles do too (70%); '+1' games and daily-reward games tend to rank lower.

Many of the 60 newly profiled games are skins on known templates (+1 with Sonic, Naruto, bow; throw-for-rarity with clowns, monsters, fish), which is consistent with low-novelty clones filling the chart.

outliers.name: Pleb's Plane Crash Sandbox
outliers.note: Top of today's new entries at #18 with 94% likes and daily updates; the physics sandbox hypothesis (72%) holds despite its low earning potential.

outliers.note: A UI-only PlayStation menu replica at #40 on the GTA 6 trend, with donation products up to 50,000 R$; likely a short-lived curiosity.

summary: No new research files today. 60 games were profiled; video frames were missing for the four queued long-running hits, so none were labeled.
The throw-for-rarity template (Clowns, Monsters, Fish, Pirates, Anime packs) now spans Up-and-Coming and Top Earning, raising H-x-045 to 38%.
Thanksgiving tags appear on eight tracked games, mostly paired with an update, nudging H-x-048 to 30%.
Four new hypotheses: novelty and title update tags on Up-and-Coming, satisfying-task cluster, and licensed skins on the +1 template.
progressions: uc→tt 329 (median 2d), tt→mp 241 (2d), uc→te 205 (5d), tt→te 187 (4d); the common path remains Up-and-Coming first, then Top Trending, then Most Popular.
